notes: Initial research index; statuses distinguish published/reported verification from checks performed inside this index repository.

points.title: OpenAI fixed-width exact #SAT complexity bound
points.statement: For each fixed k >= 2, exact counting on canonical k-CNF inputs in deterministic time polynomial in input bit length times 2^{O_k(n (log log n)^2 / sqrt(log n))}, with polynomial visited tape cells.

points.title: Anthropic uniform exact #k-SAT main theorem
points.statement: One finite-alphabet FinTM2 machine counts assignments for the stipulated k-CNF family within 2^{C min(km/sqrt(log m), k^2 n log log n/sqrt(log n))} steps, under the formal input conditions.

points.title: Anthropic formal ETH refutation
points.statement: MainResults.ETHIsFalse is the negation of 0 < MainResults.s 3, with s defined through FinTM2 decision algorithms on encClauses.

points.title: Standard deterministic Exponential Time Hypothesis
points.statement: The standard positive-rate hypothesis for deciding 3-SAT, with conventional algorithm models and reasonable encodings; distinguish its definition from formal machine-model versions.

points.title: Anthropic main theorem implies Anthropic formal ETH refutation
points.statement: The formal counting bound yields the project's formal negation of ETH.

points.title: OpenAI claim implies Anthropic ETHIsFalse
points.statement: A third-party bridge claims OAI.Algorithms.SubexponentialSAT.SqrtLogSpace.Claim -> MainResults.ETHIsFalse; source identity across different toolchains remains an explicit qualification.

points.title: Formal ETH refutation implies textbook ETH refutation
points.statement: Requires an explicit account of encoding conversion and simulation overhead between the formal machine and conventional deterministic algorithms; distinguish each existing Lean bridge from remaining informal interpretation.

points.title: Verified OpenAI-378 bridge refutes PositiveRateETH
points.statement: OAI.Bridges.ETH.not_positiveRateETH : ¬ OAI.ParityWL.Complexity.PositiveRateETH. The proof connects the bounded-width SAT theorem to the ParityLifts machine model by a canonical input converter and polynomial-overhead simulation.

points.title: OpenAI ParityLifts PositiveRateETH predicate
points.statement: Exists δ > 0 such that no finite-alphabet multitape machine decides the formal 3-CNF language in time C (L+1)^d 2^{δ N}, for any positive C and natural d. This is a formal predicate, with textbook ETH correspondence tracked separately.
